limitations.rendered_rgb: Unavailable under NullRHI; front/rear RGB correctness was not accepted.
limitations.yolo_and_camera_perception: Unavailable under NullRHI and not accepted. In addition, the current sim=true full bringup disables the CAMROD camera/YOLO pipeline; the CARLA relay publishes raw images while the existing YOLO launch expects compressed input. GPU repair alone will not make YOLO pass.
limitations.camera_pipeline_configuration: A separate default-false CARLA raw-image YOLO profile is still required. It must select one transport, prevent duplicate obstacle publishers, and validate camera/LiDAR extrinsics, intrinsics, resolution, and timestamps before perception, parking, charging, or fusion acceptance.
limitations.canonical_physics_asset_evidence: Canonical PA_Ranger promotion, file cohort, and clean persistence are VERIFIED, but the direct 5-body/4-constraint semantic inventory was taken from the Diagnostics candidate before promotion. Formal asset closure requires one read-only post-promotion DumpPhysicsAsset of the current canonical SK_Ranger/PA_Ranger with a pinned report hash.
limitations.ui_system_warning: The screenshot contains a System warning from current 5 Hz fake-sensor diagnostics; this remains an open diagnostic disposition.
limitations.navigation_scope: One initially aligned, two-goal static-lanelet action succeeded. Long or curved routes, disturbed starts, obstacles, parking, charging, and fault injection were not formally accepted by this run.
limitations.map_alignment: The existing single-anchor alignment is not a multi-point survey acceptance.
limitations.shutdown_noise: Most nodes exited cleanly, but the two physical controller wrappers and the external spawn/bridge wrappers emitted exit-code-1 double-rcl_shutdown errors; the UI backend emitted one shutdown-time Python-object conversion RuntimeError. No runtime unsafe-command symptom was observed, actor/sensors and owned ports were cleared, but clean-shutdown acceptance remains pending.
limitations.hardware: No real Ranger CAN, actuator, BMS, sensor, or emergency-stop acceptance is claimed.

regression_tests.statement: Final targeted builds and regressions for every modified CAMROD package plus the CARLA controller and adapter completed with zero failures. The eight skips are reported, not counted as passes.

voice.reason: SDL2_mixer development dependency was unavailable; the live full launch used enable_voice=false.

historical_context.previous_scope: Earlier bounded mode smokes plus one 1.5 m NavigateToPose goal; retained as historical evidence and not substituted for this latest-develop full-launch run.
